title: Questions about Volta Support
bug_description: ### 📚 The doc issue In the release notes, I saw that support for the Volta architecture was dropped. However, I also found pull requests, such as [#157968](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/157968), that were merged into the releases/2.8 branch and appear to add Volta support. cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
